title: Cluj Napoca earn Liga Nationala title
description: Cluj Napoca - Oradea 86-67 Cluj Napoca celebrated Liga Nationala title. They topped Oradea in the decider to lift the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Cluj Napoca. Oradea managed to win second period 19-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 16-of-20 free shots (80.0 percent) during the game. The best player for the winners was Lithuanian forward Donatas Tarolis (207-94) who scored 24 points and 7 rebounds (on 8-of-9 shooting from the field). Bosnian-Croatian center Andrija Stipanovic (208-86, agency: BeoBasket) chipped in 13 points and 9 rebounds. Four Cluj Napoca players scored in double figures. American guard Aaron Broussard (196-90, college: Seattle) produced 18 points and 6 rebounds and the other American import guard Stephen Holt (193-91, college: St.Mary's, CA) added 7 points respectively for the guests.
